source.commit: Add mountain tulip and treats Memory art

candidate.method: Production-config build:android output copied once; preview served from frozen copy on explicit IPv4 loopback; no deployment.

checks.productionBuild: npm run build:android: passed; stale Browserslist data and >500kB chunk-size advisory warnings only

browser.journey: Normal UI: selected Amari and Memory Match; earned levels 1-9 using visible card flips and Next Level; replayed earned Party, Dino, Food, and Garden boards using visible level controls. No progress/deck/hidden-face injection.

targetProof.lolly: Party & Treats, level 4; Yummy Feast, level 7
targetProof.chips: Party & Treats, level 4; Yummy Feast, level 7

browser.layout: 1280 desktop target cards 149-182px; 390 mobile target cards 82x82px. Each new 512px art image appeared after a real flip with its matching caption. Face-down checks covered 24, 26, 30, and 34 cards; all had no descendant img.
browser.guards: Final guarded context used 403 routes for **/api/voice and **/api/story. Route list verified before and after goto and after the target replays. Current request listing showed only static requests omitted from default display; console had 0 errors, 0 warnings.
browser.guardLimitation: An earlier preliminary run used open <appURL> after routing about:blank; open recreated the context and dropped those guards. That preliminary run is superseded. The final captured replay used goto with both routes confirmed active.

scope: Builder evidence only. Independent rendered QA, human listening, full premium-art gate, release, deployment, and 4.5 score remain open.
